enrichment.core_claim: Tryptophan networks in microtubules may support light-driven energy transfer, giving a testable quantum biophotonic framework relevant to neural function and consciousness.
enrichment.ask_question: What experimental signature of energy transfer through tryptophan networks are you most excited to measure?
enrichment.challenge_question: Even if microtubules show optical energy transfer, what links that property to consciousness rather than ordinary cell biology?
